PROPERTIES.player_hint_1_en: Look at Felix: every square he could still use shares a row or column with row 6, column 2. So nobody else can stand at row 6, column 2, or Felix would have nowhere to go.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_2_en: Conrad and Bella can't share a row or column, so Conrad's clue ("He was exactly one row north of Bella.") rules out more squares for Conrad.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_3_en: Suppose Conrad were at row 6, column 9: then Felix and Harriet would have to share a row or column. So Conrad can't be there.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_4_en: The same kind of reasoning rules out a few more squares. So Alma (A) must be at row 2, column 6. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_5_en: Suppose Vera were at row 3, column 5: then the general clue ("There was exactly one person beside a piano.") could not be true. So Vera can't be there.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_6_en: Suppose Vera were at row 3, column 7: then the general clue ("There was exactly one person beside a piano.") could not be true. So Vera can't be there.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_7_en: Suppose Grant were at row 1, column 9: then Bella and Vera would have to share a row or column. So Grant can't be there.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_8_en: The same kind of reasoning rules out a few more squares. Dahlia is now the only person who can still go in row 3. So Dahlia (D) must be at row 3, column 4. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_9_en: With the rows and columns of Alma and Dahlia crossed out, only one square is left for Ezra that fits his clue ("Someone else in his area was beside a speaker."). So Ezra (E) must be at row 4, column 1. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_10_en: Who can be the person beside a piano in Dahlia's area? Only Conrad, because nobody else can still reach a square that fits Dahlia's clue ("Someone else in her area was beside a piano."). That rules out Conrad's other squares. So Conrad (C) must be at row 5, column 3. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_11_en: With the rows and columns of everyone placed so far crossed out, only one square is left for Felix that fits his clue ("He was the only person beside a chest."). So Felix (F) must be at row 7, column 2. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_12_en: With the rows and columns of everyone placed so far crossed out, only one square is left for Bella that fits her clue ("She was in the Orchestra Pit, but not beside a piano."). So Bella (B) must be at row 6, column 7. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_13_en: With the rows and columns of everyone placed so far crossed out, only one square is left for Grant that fits his clue ("He was exactly three rows north of Ezra."). So Grant (G) must be at row 1, column 5. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_14_en: With the rows and columns of everyone placed so far crossed out, only one square is left for Harriet that fits her clue ("She was beside a register and a sign."). So Harriet (H) must be at row 8, column 9. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_15_en: With the rows and columns of everyone placed so far crossed out, only one square is left for Vera. So Vera (the victim) must be at row 9, column 8. Cross out her row and column. Harriet is the only person in the Box Office with Vera, so Harriet is the murderer!
